Service raises questions concerning the effects of Jocassee operation and, in turn, the proposed project. Presented as Figures 1 - 3 are water temnerature profiles for the September sampling periods of 1973, 1974, and 1975. Their approximate location is shown on the enclosed location map. Utilizing dissolved oxygen data collected for the same period and the accepted non-stress trout habitat limits of 5.0 mg/l dissolved oxygen and 20 degrees C, the areas of suitable trout habitat were developed as shown. A significant decrease in habitat has occurred during the past three years at these points. This data is not conclusive by any means, but raise many questions concerning highly complex problems. The applicant has offered to supply extensive data collected during studies so that our engineering consultants can further evaluate this potential problem. It is requested that the staff also perform an analysis of this data although this has probably been accomplished. We will submit further technical comments on this matter after a reasonable analysis has been performed.
See preceding response.
